candidates.statement: POLICY CDER’s mission-essential functions shall continue effectively and without interruptions because of CDER’s implemented, maintained and viable Continuity of Operations Program (COOP).
candidates.context: BACKGROUND Presidential Decision Directive 67 requires all Federal agencies to develop Continuity of Operations Plans for operations. The subsequent Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Federal Preparedness Circular 65 and Federal Continuity Directive 1 and 2 detail the mandatory requirements for Federal COOP Plans. Effective Date: 07/08/15; 07/21/21 Page 2 of 7 RESPONSIBILITIES The Center Director:

candidates.statement: • Identifying essential personnel who must be available during emergencies.
candidates.context: 1. Using the most recent CDER COOP Plan template, Office Director and Office COOP Coordinator develop a plan for their Office to include: • Identifying essential functions. • Designating orders of succession and delegations of authority.
